notes: Liliana, Waker of the Dead, printed: '[-7]: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of combat on your turn, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. ..."' Only a CREATURE card may be chosen. Both graveyards hold one noncreature card each (an instant and a sorcery) and no creature card, so the emblem's trigger has no target: nothing is put onto the battlefield and both cards stay where they are.
